payout_quote: Earn your cash bonus of up to $2,500 in three steps: Open a new eligible Business Advantage Fundamentals Banking or Business Advantage Relationship Banking account by November 30, 2026. Deposit New Money: Within 30 days of account opening (Deposit Period), deposit New Money directly into your new eligible Business Advantage Banking account. During the Maintenance Period: maintain a daily balance that meets the applicable Balance Requirement for your Cash Bonus Tier. If your daily balance falls below the minimum of the Balance Requirement listed for a specific Cash Bonus Tier during the Maintenance Period, you may be eligible for a lower tier (if applicable), based on the lowest daily balance maintained. If your daily balance falls below $5,000 on any day during the Maintenance Period, you will no longer be eligible for a cash bonus. After you satisfy all the requirements, we will attempt to deposit the earned bonus directly into your Business Advantage Banking account within sixty (60) days. The Business Advantage Banking account must be open and in good standing up to and including the date any earned bonus is paid. You will only receive one cash bonus, corresponding to the highest Cash Bonus Tier for which you qualify. Bank of America may withhold tax or other amounts from the payment. Bank of America may issue an IRS Form 1099 (or other appropriate form) to you that reflects the value of such bonus. Please consult your tax advisor, as neither Bank of America, its affiliates, nor their employees provide tax advice.
steps: Confirm you are a new business customer (not an owner or signer on a Bank of America Business Advantage account within the last 12 months).

Open a new eligible Business Advantage Fundamentals or Relationship Banking account by November 30, 2026 - online through the offer page (code applied automatically) or through an associate who applies the offer code at account opening.
Within 30 days of account opening, deposit New Money directly into the account: $5,000 for $400, $15,000 for $700, $50,000 for $1,000, $100,000 for $1,500, or $200,000 for $2,500.
Complete the balance maintenance period per the full terms; receive the bonus once all requirements are met.
catches: Business customers only - requires a business entity; new customers only (no BofA Business Advantage ownership within the last 12 months).
Large new-money deposits required - $5,000 minimum even for the lowest tier; $200,000 for the top tier.

Maintenance Period balance discipline: if your daily balance falls below your tier minimum on any day, you drop to a lower tier; below $5,000 on any day and you lose the bonus entirely (official terms).
The offer code must be applied at the time of account opening - opening through the wrong path forfeits the bonus.
New money only; funds already at Bank of America do not count.
One bonus per business owner regardless of the number of businesses owned or operated.
Bank of America employees are not eligible.
Official terms: Bank of America may issue an IRS Form 1099 (or other appropriate form) reflecting the bonus value; consult a tax advisor.
Account must be open and in good standing when the bonus is paid (within 60 days after all requirements).
Fees: official page states no monthly fee for the first 12 months on Business Advantage Fundamentals Banking; standard monthly fees may apply thereafter per the account terms.
biggest_catch: Business-only with a $5,000 new-money minimum for the lowest tier, and the top $2,500 tier requires parking $200,000 in new money; the offer code must be applied at account opening.
eligibility: New Bank of America business customers (no ownership of a BofA Business Advantage account in the last 12 months); not a BofA employee; one bonus per business owner.
timing: After all requirements are satisfied, BofA will attempt to deposit the earned bonus directly into the Business Advantage Banking account within sixty (60) days; the account must be open and in good standing up to and including the payment date.
